State the user intent first. Put files, approach, and commands after that. Do not paste agent remarks as the issue. Name every open decision. Do not decide it here. Fill reporter evidence only. Omit a heading marked optional when it does not apply. Do not fill that heading with None.

When the increment sets a new performance target, file here. When a stated performance bound already failed, file Quality. When the evidence supports both, file Quality and leave Issue Sub-Typing labels off.

Issue Sub-Typing is a label. Leave `new`, `performance`, and `technical-debt` off when Unknown. Apply one of those labels when this issue already holds the evidence.

- Milestones
- Ownership
